-- NEBULA YIELD - Single-file command framework for your own Roblox Experience
-- Infinite-Yield-inspired, but independently implemented.
-- Client-side utilities only; server authority belongs in your own game code.

local Players=game:GetService('Players')
local UIS=game:GetService('UserInputService')
local RunService=game:GetService('RunService')
local TweenService=game:GetService('TweenService')
local Lighting=game:GetService('Lighting')
local TeleportService=game:GetService('TeleportService')
local LP=Players.LocalPlayer
local PG=LP:WaitForChild('PlayerGui')
local PREFIX=';'
local State={open=true,history={},values={},connections={},effects={}}
local Theme={bg=Color3.fromRGB(9,9,15),panel=Color3.fromRGB(17,17,27),card=Color3.fromRGB(24,24,39),accent=Color3.fromRGB(150,80,255),text=Color3.fromRGB(245,245,255),muted=Color3.fromRGB(155,155,180),good=Color3.fromRGB(90,230,150),bad=Color3.fromRGB(255,90,110)}
local Commands={}; local Index={}
local function disconnect(k) if State.connections[k] then State.connections[k]:Disconnect();State.connections[k]=nil end end
local function track(k,c) disconnect(k);State.connections[k]=c;return c end
local function root(p) local c=(p or LP).Character;return c and c:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart') end
local function hum(p) local c=(p or LP).Character;return c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid') end
local function players(q)
 q=string.lower(tostring(q or 'me')); if q=='me' or q=='' then return {LP} end
 if q=='all' then return Players:GetPlayers() end
 if q=='others' then local t={};for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do if p~=LP then table.insert(t,p) end end;return t end
 local t={};for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do if p.Name:lower():sub(1,#q)==q or p.DisplayName:lower():sub(1,#q)==q then table.insert(t,p) end end;return t
end
local function notify(title,msg,kind) if _G.NebulaNotify then _G.NebulaNotify(title,msg,kind) end end
local function reg(n,cat,desc,syntax,fn,aliases)
 local c={Name=n,Category=cat,Description=desc,Syntax=syntax or PREFIX..n,Example=syntax or PREFIX..n,Execute=fn,Aliases=aliases or {}}
 table.insert(Commands,c);Index[n:lower()]=c;for _,a in ipairs(c.Aliases) do Index[a:lower()]=c end
end
local function regSimple(n,cat,d,fn,aliases) reg(n,cat,d,PREFIX..n,fn,aliases) end

-- Core
regSimple('help','System','Shows command information.',function(a)local c=Index[(a[1] or ''):lower()];if c then notify(c.Name,c.Description..'\nSyntax: '..c.Syntax) else notify('Help',#Commands..' commands loaded.')end end,{'h','?'})
regSimple('cmds','System','Opens/searches the command browser.',function(a) Search.Text=table.concat(a,' ') end,{'commands'})
regSimple('history','System','Shows recent commands.',function() notify('History',#State.history==0 and 'Empty' or table.concat(State.history,'\n')) end)
regSimple('clearhistory','System','Clears command history.',function() table.clear(State.history);notify('History','Cleared','success') end)
regSimple('speed','Movement','Changes WalkSpeed. Usage: ;speed [player] [amount]',function(a)local target=a[2] and a[1] or 'me';local v=tonumber(a[2] or a[1]) or 16;for _,p in ipairs(players(target)) do local h=hum(p);if h then h.WalkSpeed=v end end end,{'ws','walkspeed'})
regSimple('jump','Movement','Changes JumpPower. Usage: ;jump [player] [amount]',function(a)local target=a[2] and a[1] or 'me';local v=tonumber(a[2] or a[1]) or 50;for _,p in ipairs(players(target)) do local h=hum(p);if h then h.UseJumpPower=true;h.JumpPower=v end end end,{'jp','jumppower'})
regSimple('sit','Character','Makes a target sit.',function(a)for _,p in ipairs(players(a[1])) do local h=hum(p);if h then h.Sit=true end end end)
regSimple('unsit','Character','Makes a target stand.',function(a)for _,p in ipairs(players(a[1])) do local h=hum(p);if h then h.Sit=false end end end,{'stand'})
regSimple('tp','Teleport','Teleports you to a player.',function(a)local t=players(a[1])[1];local r=root();local tr=root(t);if r and tr then r.CFrame=tr.CFrame+Vector3.new(0,3,0) end end,{'goto','teleport'})
regSimple('bring','Teleport','Moves a target to your local position.',function(a)local r=root();if not r then return end;for _,p in ipairs(players(a[1])) do local x=root(p);if x then x.CFrame=r.CFrame+Vector3.new(0,0,-3) end end end)
regSimple('noclip','Movement','Disables collisions on your character.',function()track('noclip',RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()local c=LP.Character;if c then for _,x in ipairs(c:GetDescendants()) do if x:IsA('BasePart') then x.CanCollide=false end end end end))end)
regSimple('clip','Movement','Restores normal local collision updates.',function()disconnect('noclip')end)
regSimple('fov','Visual','Changes camera field of view.',function(a)local c=workspace.CurrentCamera;if c then c.FieldOfView=math.clamp(tonumber(a[1]) or 70,1,120)end end)
regSimple('fullbright','Visual','Enables bright local lighting.',function()Lighting.Brightness=3;Lighting.ClockTime=14;Lighting.FogEnd=100000;Lighting.GlobalShadows=false end)
regSimple('unfullbright','Visual','Restores basic lighting defaults.',function()Lighting.Brightness=2;Lighting.ClockTime=14;Lighting.FogEnd=100000;Lighting.GlobalShadows=true end)
regSimple('gravity','World','Changes local workspace gravity.',function(a)workspace.Gravity=tonumber(a[1]) or 196.2 end)
regSimple('time','World','Changes local clock time.',function(a)Lighting.ClockTime=tonumber(a[1]) or 12 end)
regSimple('freeze','Character','Anchors target roots locally.',function(a)for _,p in ipairs(players(a[1])) do local r=root(p);if r then r.Anchored=true end end end)
regSimple('unfreeze','Character','Unanchors target roots locally.',function(a)for _,p in ipairs(players(a[1])) do local r=root(p);if r then r.Anchored=false end end end)
regSimple('respawn','Character','Resets target characters.',function(a)for _,p in ipairs(players(a[1])) do local h=hum(p);if h then h.Health=0 end end end,{'reset'})
regSimple('rejoin','Utility','Rejoins the current place.',function()TeleportService:Teleport(game.PlaceId,LP)end)
regSimple('serverid','Utility','Displays the current JobId.',function()notify('JobId',game.JobId)end)
regSimple('userid','Utility','Displays a target UserId.',function(a)local p=players(a[1])[1];if p then notify('UserId',tostring(p.UserId))end end)

-- UI
local Gui=Instance.new('ScreenGui');Gui.Name='NebulaYield';Gui.ResetOnSpawn=false;Gui.Parent=PG
local Main=Instance.new('Frame');Main.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(760,510);Main.Position=UDim2.new(.5,-380,.5,-255);Main.BackgroundColor3=Theme.bg;Main.Parent=Gui;Instance.new('UICorner',Main).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,18)
local Stroke=Instance.new('UIStroke',Main);Stroke.Color=Theme.accent;Stroke.Transparency=.45
local Top=Instance.new('Frame',Main);Top.BackgroundTransparency=1;Top.Size=UDim2.new(1,-24,0,65);Top.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(12,8)
local Title=Instance.new('TextLabel',Top);Title.BackgroundTransparency=1;Title.Text='NEBULA YIELD';Title.TextColor3=Theme.text;Title.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold;Title.TextSize=21;Title.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left;Title.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(260,30);Title.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(8,2)
local Sub=Instance.new('TextLabel',Top);Sub.BackgroundTransparency=1;Sub.Text='Command palette • tooltips • history • themes';Sub.TextColor3=Theme.muted;Sub.Font=Enum.Font.Gotham;Sub.TextSize=11;Sub.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left;Sub.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(300,22);Sub.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(8,34)
Search=Instance.new('TextBox',Top);Search.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(320,38);Search.Position=UDim2.new(1,-320,0,8);Search.BackgroundColor3=Theme.panel;Search.TextColor3=Theme.text;Search.PlaceholderColor3=Theme.muted;Search.PlaceholderText='Search commands...';Search.ClearTextOnFocus=false;Search.Font=Enum.Font.Gotham;Search.TextSize=14;Instance.new('UICorner',Search).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,10)
local List=Instance.new('ScrollingFrame',Main);List.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(12,80);List.Size=UDim2.new(1,-24,1,-92);List.BackgroundTransparency=1;List.ScrollBarThickness=4;local Lay=Instance.new('UIListLayout',List);Lay.Padding=UDim.new(0,7)
local function refresh(q)for _,x in ipairs(List:GetChildren())do if x:IsA('GuiObject') and x~=Lay then x:Destroy()end end;q=(q or ''):lower();local n=0;for _,c in ipairs(Commands)do local hay=(c.Name..' '..c.Description..' '..c.Category):lower();if q=='' or hay:find(q,1,true)then local b=Instance.new('TextButton',List);b.Size=UDim2.new(1,-8,0,62);b.BackgroundColor3=Theme.card;b.Text='';Instance.new('UICorner',b).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,10);local a=Instance.new('TextLabel',b);a.BackgroundTransparency=1;a.Text=PREFIX..c.Name;a.TextColor3=Theme.text;a.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold;a.TextSize=14;a.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left;a.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(14,7);a.Size=UDim2.new(.45,0,0,20);local d=Instance.new('TextLabel',b);d.BackgroundTransparency=1;d.Text=c.Description;d.TextColor3=Theme.muted;d.Font=Enum.Font.Gotham;d.TextSize=11;d.TextWrapped=true;d.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left;d.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(14,29);d.Size=UDim2.new(.75,0,0,26);b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()notify(c.Name,c.Description..'\nSyntax: '..c.Syntax..'\nExample: '..c.Example)end);n+=1;if n>=300 then break end end end;List.CanvasSize=UDim2.fromOffset(0,Lay.AbsoluteContentSize.Y+10)end
Search:GetPropertyChangedSignal('Text'):Connect(function()refresh(Search.Text)end)
local Bar=Instance.new('TextBox',Gui);Bar.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(580,42);Bar.Position=UDim2.new(.5,-290,1,-62);Bar.BackgroundColor3=Theme.panel;Bar.TextColor3=Theme.text;Bar.PlaceholderColor3=Theme.muted;Bar.PlaceholderText=';speed me 50';Bar.Font=Enum.Font.Gotham;Bar.TextSize=14;Bar.ClearTextOnFocus=false;Instance.new('UICorner',Bar).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,12)
_G.NebulaNotify=function(t,m,k) local n=Instance.new('TextLabel',Gui);n.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(340,70);n.Position=UDim2.new(1,-360,0,20);n.BackgroundColor3=Theme.panel;n.TextColor3=Theme.text;n.Font=Enum.Font.Gotham;n.TextSize=12;n.TextWrapped=true;n.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left;n.TextYAlignment=Enum.TextYAlignment.Top;n.Text='  '..t..'\n  '..m;Instance.new('UICorner',n).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,12);task.delay(4,function()if n then n:Destroy()end end)end
local function execute(s)if s:sub(1,#PREFIX)~=PREFIX then return end;local a={};for x in s:sub(#PREFIX+1):gmatch('%S+')do table.insert(a,x)end;local name=table.remove(a,1):lower();local c=Index[name];if not c then notify('Unknown command',name,'error');return end;table.insert(State.history,1,s);if #State.history>60 then table.remove(State.history)end;local ok,e=pcall(c.Execute,a);if not ok then notify('Command error',tostring(e),'error')end end
Bar.FocusLost:Connect(function(enter)if enter then execute(Bar.Text);Bar.Text=''end end)
UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(i,p)if p then return end;if i.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.RightShift then State.open=not State.open;Main.Visible=State.open;Bar.Visible=State.open elseif i.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.Semicolon and not UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() then Bar:CaptureFocus();Bar.Text=PREFIX end end)
